_comment: Cross-runtime vectors for the cross-Domain commit-reveal SAS-AKE (cross-domain-sas.ts). Read by src/__tests__/cross-domain-sas.test.ts (TS) AND, in the Phase F Android pass, by SasCryptoTest.kt (Kotlin), so the hand-authored Kotlin twin (SasCrypto.kt) cannot drift from this TS reference. Each `a`/`b` is a CrossDomainParty (ownerSignPub, gatewaySignPub, gatewayBoxPub, domainId, gatewayId). `sas` is the 12 decimal digits (SHA-256 of the SAS_V1 preimage -> first 8 bytes big-endian BigInt -> mod 10^12 -> zero-pad 12). A `commitment` is base64 SHA-256 of the SAS_COMMIT_V1 preimage over one party + salt.

orderIndependent._comment: Swapping party a and b yields the SAME SAS as cases[0]: the preimage sorts all ten identity fields as a flat list, so each side derives the same code regardless of which side it is.

substitution._comment: cases[0] with party a's gatewayBoxPub swapped for an unrelated key -> the SAS MUST differ from cases[0].sas. A committed-to substitution still yields a different code, which is the residual MITM detector once the commitment closes the offline grind.

commitment._comment: SHA-256(base64) of the SAS_COMMIT_V1 preimage over party a + salt. The peer re-derives this from the revealed party+salt and aborts on a mismatch (the commit-reveal binding).

commitmentSaltBinding._comment: The SAME party with a DIFFERENT salt yields a DIFFERENT commitment, so the salt is load-bearing (it hides the public keys).

handComputed._comment: Tiny non-key strings so the test can assert the EXACT canonical preimages and recompute by hand. The SAS preimage sorts the ten fields lexicographically; the commitment preimage is fixed-order.
